newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna upgraded to buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said Wednesday analyst Robert Hoehn upgraded Aetna Inc to buy from hold.
-- Cut 1997 earnings estimate to $5.15 per share from $5.50.
-- Cut 1998 estimate to $6.25 per share from $6.50.
-- In research note, Hoehn said he was raising the rating despite cutting estimates for several reasons, including Aetna's leading market position in consolidating HMO industry.

-- Also said, "While operating earnings for the company were below expectations in the second quarter and boosted by the reversal of a charge, the problems in the quarter should be, in our view, resolved within the next six months."
